title: Correct source-bound release version truth after v0.5.49 post-publish audit
outOfScope: Rewriting, deleting, or re-publishing immutable v0.5.49 tag or Release assets.
Bypassing public distribution, source identity, or provider asset verification.
Changing unrelated installer, governance, or adopter behavior.

sources.reason: Post-publish check_release_distribution failure: source version.json releaseVersion 0.5.32 conflicts with requested tag v0.5.49.
Release finalization must bind source, tag, runtime projection, assets, and public verification.
Authoritative public installer and source identity verifier that detected the contradiction.
Current stale source version fact that must be made source-bound for the corrective release.

riskAssessment.reason: A stable public release has exposed contradictory version metadata; correction must preserve immutable v0.5.49 evidence and publish only a verified successor.

reasons: Public release identity and immutable provider assets require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized the complete plan and corrective release workflow; immutable v0.5.49 remains out of scope.

preReviewWarnings: Review source-version, tag, Release asset, and public installation identity as one immutable tuple.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The post-publish public verifier rejects v0.5.49 with the exact stale version.json fact recorded; v0.5.49 remains immutable and is never claimed valid.

Release preparation and finalization derive one source-bound version fact so version.json, candidate metadata, requested tag, runtime release projection, Release assets, and public installer agree for the corrective successor.
Release preflight and the provider workflow fail closed before tag mutation when source version metadata disagrees with the requested release tag, with regression tests for stale and matched cases.

The corrective successor is v0.5.50 after reserved v0.5.49, with a release-ready handoff that requires same-SHA rehearsal, provider publication, post-publish public installation verification, and #625 closure only after the final cleanup audit.

intent.problem: v0.5.49 provider publication succeeded but the public distribution verifier found version.json.releaseVersion 0.5.32 in the immutable source, creating multiple version truths and rejecting real installation.
constraints: Do not rewrite, delete, or claim validity for v0.5.49.

Release only a new monotonically increasing patch after exact-source rehearsal, provider asset, and public installer evidence pass.
